about_short_description.short_description: CData Software is a software company that offers data integration solutions for real-time access to applications, databases, and Web APIs.

product.name: CData Connect AI
product.description: A managed Model Context Protocol platform that provides governed, live access to SaaS applications, databases, APIs, and on-premises systems for AI assistants and agents.

product.name: CData Drivers and Connectors
product.description: Standards-based drivers and connectors that provide live, relational access to hundreds of SaaS applications, databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and on-premises systems.

product.name: CData Sync
product.description: A data integration platform for ETL, ELT, change data capture, replication, transformations, and reverse ETL between cloud and on-premises sources and destinations.

product.name: CData Embed
product.description: An embeddable connectivity offering that lets software providers add live access to hundreds of enterprise data sources and provide data-driven or AI features inside their products.

product.name: CData Arc
product.description: An integration platform for electronic data interchange, managed file transfer, and business-to-business data exchange workflows.

product.name: CData API Server
product.description: A server product that exposes databases and other data sources through RESTful APIs, enabling application and service access to enterprise data.
